text:
No bond remains: everything is broken.

Heaven willed it so: blessed be its will!

I gladly drain the bitter cup;

my soul rests at last and desires nothing.


I loved you; I love you no longer—or so I think.

If I am wrong, may I never see the truth!

Let oblivion swallow so many bitter years;

let my heart breathe again.


You shattered it without pity; my pride

you trampled over and over in your frenzy...

Yet my lips will never breathe a murmur

to accuse you of your tyranny.


As the dread avenger of grave offenses,

you dutifully fulfilled your mission; do you know it?

The irresistible power that laid my strength

prostrate before you was not yours.


God willed it, and so it was: glory to his name!

All is over; I draw breath again.

Angel of vengeance! You are a man now...

I feel neither love nor fear when I behold you.


Your scepter fell, your sword grew dull...

But ah, how sadly I breathe this freedom!

I made a world of you, and now it falls to nothing,

leaving me in deep and boundless solitude.


May you live happily! If someday

you see this farewell I send you forever,

know that in my soul you still have

generous forgiveness and tender affection.
